note: SNS-2026-LIVE-ANDROID-FIX-001: Android-specific Live initialization repair. Root cause: numeric separator literals (15_000, 90_000, etc.) in live.js and snx-sfu.js cause a SyntaxError on Android Chrome/WebView versions that do not support ES2021 numeric separators. This prevented live.js from parsing, so snxLivePageOpen was never defined — resulting in stuck 'Loading live streams...' and the initialization failure toast. _loadESModule was also silently swallowing the parse error, masking the failure. Fixes: (1) All numeric separator literals in live.js replaced with plain integers. (2) All numeric separator literals in snx-sfu.js replaced with plain integers. (3) _loadESModule now re-throws parse/import errors with full diagnostic metadata. (4) loadFeature catch now logs full [LIVE INIT ERROR] object. (5) [LIVE] 1-9 diagnostic checkpoints added to snx-feature-loader.js and live.js. (6) index.html live navTo block: loading UI replaced with unavailable message + RETRY LIVE button on failure (no page reload, no duplicate listeners). (7) index.html BUILD_ID/SW_VER updated to SNS-2026-LIVE-ANDROID-FIX-001/v100. SW CACHE_VERSION unchanged (v100) — cached files already at v100 from previous repair build; no new SW bump required. iPhone Live path unchanged. Firebase rules unchanged. WebRTC unchanged.
